reviews.title: Love love love! Perfect for gamer girls 🐱
reviews.comment: Super cute and comfy!! I have a pair of the more expensive brand on Amazon and I prefer these as they are little less depth in cushion. The expensive brand were such a thick cushion for my head it was squeezing too much. These have the perfect amount of depth to fit perfectly on my head comfortably.
reviews.author: Hannah

reviews.title: Wow. Excellent.
reviews.comment: At first I was skeptical it would actually help with quality. After vigorous testing to make sure it wasn't placebo, I can confirm it makes the lows and mids in music pop. Much richer and deeper tone. The stock pads are not only a dust magnet, they also didn't fully encompass my ears, and I didn't realize that until I tried these on. Tons of room. Total quality of life improvement. These are great and worth the money.
reviews.author: jason v.

reviews.title: Amazing Product!
reviews.comment:
I work from home and use my HS80 Max Corsair headset for over 6 hours a day. The standard pads were hurting my ears, by pushing my glasses into the side of my head. Heat was never a concern for me.
I ordered these and it was a very easy install. As soon as I placed them on, I could instantly tell the different. It was cooler and definitely more comfortable. Great addition to an amazing headset!
reviews.author: Patrick Dabson

reviews.title: Very good quality
reviews.comment:
The quality and feeling is very good, comfy and cool, as described.
The only issue is that small hole/cut that is present there shown by the yellow arrow, which I hope won't cause an issue by extending further. If it stays like that for at least 3 years, then not a big issue for me, will prove itself. Although that would also mean that without this faulty site, it could stay properly even longer.
Overall, satisfied.
reviews.author: Anna
